purpose: Measure what the corpus actually CONTAINS, so the cost and bandwidth model rests on measured duration rather than on a planning estimate.

THE_FINDING_THAT_CHANGES_THE_PLAN.statement: Every call ships as a QUARTET: .mp3 + .mp4 + .pdf + 'AI Summary'.pdf, and MEGA renders INLINE DURATIONS for the media files.
consequences: MP3s ALREADY EXIST. The spoken half needs NO video download and NO ffmpeg transcode. The MP3 can be streamed or downloaded and POSTed to Deepgram as-is.
AUDIO DURATION IS MEASURABLE from the listing. The cost input is obtainable; it is not an unknowable.
PRE-EXISTING 'AI Summary' PDFs ARE A FREE WRITTEN REGISTER. The operator was right to suspect them.
The original .pdf per call is the authored written half.
Bandwidth collapses from the full 319.95 GB to roughly the MP3+PDF fraction, because the MP4s are never fetched.

structure_verified.note: 2024 pairs June+July into one folder, so months are NOT uniformly 12 per year.

KNOWN_MEASUREMENT_DEFECTS: 2025/Feb: one MP3 renders with duration '00:00' while its MP4 sibling shows 1:30:31. The mp3 and mp4 totals therefore differ (87972 vs 93404). This is a REAL ANOMALY, not smoothed over, and it is exactly the shape the duration gate exists to catch. Cause NOT RECORDED.

2024/Jan returned only 8 parsed rows and zero PDFs, which is plausibly incomplete: MEGA's list is virtualised and only renders visible rows. Row counts from this method are a LOWER BOUND until scrolling is added.
Only 3 of ~38 month folders were sampled. The hour total below is an EXTRAPOLATION and is labelled as one.

ESTIMATE_clearly_labelled_as_an_estimate.basis: 3 sampled months range 15.07h - 25.36h of MP3 audio. Month-folder count is UNVERIFIED for 2021-2023.
ESTIMATE_clearly_labelled_as_an_estimate.month_folder_count_assumed: ~38 (11 for 2024 + 2 for 2025 + assumed ~12 each for 2022 and 2023 + 1 for 2021). THE 2022/2023 ASSUMPTION IS UNVERIFIED.
ESTIMATE_clearly_labelled_as_an_estimate.forecast_cost_range: THIS IS A FORECAST FROM AN EXTRAPOLATION, NOT A MEASUREMENT. audio-and-stt.md requires budgeting from measured duration. Before spending, the month folders must actually be enumerated and the durations summed. Treat ~$196 as an order-of-magnitude guide only.

bandwidth_resolution.why_that_was_not_actually_a_blocker: It assumed downloading everything. MP4s are never needed for a transcript. Fetching MP3 + PDF only removes the dominant volume.
bandwidth_resolution.status: SOLVED BY SCOPE, not by storage. The MP4 payload is simply not acquired.
